coordinate_note: Per-site numbers were collected from published sources (LRO, Kaguya, Chandrayaan, Apollo, Luna, Chang'e, published papers) with source URLs. status=sourced means a URL exists; unverified means no published number was found (leave empty, do not estimate); weak_source means the only source is Wikipedia and should be replaced. Site coordinates are from IAU/USGS gazetteer or mission reports.
